question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1a9b25833b5df6ff166dc715a8dde7da4e317706e38916a68b9829c960cde46.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The '*' element shift clockwise.

2) The letter element rotates 90º clockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d5400875fa3a7be2865f683884a79b845503ffcb6716178731a6eb5df636a61.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2cff3c8f80f0e77db2d8eb7863e0b5b0e25f79331a89869b9ee8573cc3bc65b.png] 

Hence. "Option 2" is the correct answer.
